description: NOS Nova AS operates as a clean energy company in Norway. The company offers carbon capture and storage solutions; and midstream CCS infrastructure, as well as provides consulting and engineering services; and sales of technology. Its projects include the Gismarvik CO2 hub in Rogaland, Norway; and the Polaris CO2 commercial carbon storage project. The company was formerly known as Horisont Energi AS and changed its name to NOS Nova AS in December 2025. NOS Nova AS was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in Sandnes, Norway.
